title: SG-10.2 Push the keyboard-focused object into the scene
summary: A store focus change shows the same highlight and label in the scene as hover, and focus is removed on shutdown
description: Context: BootScene already maps Tab and arrow keys to moveFocus and emits focusChange, and SceneObject.focus() already shows the hover highlight and label. The shared game store has no focus field, so React cannot push focus into the scene. Desired behavior: the store owns the focused object id, BootScene applies it to its SceneObjects, and shutdown removes focus. Expected result: a store focus change highlights the matching object with its label. Why: keyboard focus must look the same as hover.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with objects, when the store focus id changes to an object id, then that SceneObject is focused and the others are blurred
Given a focused object, when the scene shuts down, then every SceneObject is blurred and the store focus id is null
Given the store focus id is null, when the store changes, then no SceneObject stays focused

in_scope: game store focus field and setter
BootScene focus sync from the store
preserve: existing BootScene sync and shutdown cleanup

technical_constraints: Phaser 3.90 and zustand; no new dependencies
Phaser is mocked in unit tests
definition_of_done: All requirements have Act and Verify units done
